text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Sant tells political meeting on Malta's sister island Gozo that more tourists are visiting and more jobs are being created for Gozitans, saving them having to travel to Malta.

- Chinese sailing junk arrives in Malta's Grand Harbour on trip from Hong Kong to London; it was to have arrived in London at end of June to coincide with Hong Hong handover ceremonies but was held up in Vietnam and India, then ran into storms.
- Shopowners complain sales are down heavily, attributing loss to fewer tourists.
- Hordes of jellyfish drift into Melleiha Bay, Malta's most popular beach, causing panic.
